frames.visible_job: Draws one long connected airplane body angled gently upward to the right with a rounded nose and tapered tail base.
frames.instruction: Ghost a shallow rising route twice, then pull the upper fuselage from the narrow tail base into one rounded right-facing nose. Return along the lower edge and close the body at the tail, keeping the middle broad and the silhouette face-free.

frames.step_name: Sweep out the wings and engine
frames.visible_job: Adds one broad near wing, one smaller far wing, and one attached engine pod beneath the near wing.
frames.instruction: From the fuselage middle, sweep one broad near wing down and left, then add one shorter far wing above the body. Hang one oval-ended engine pod beneath the near wing with a short pylon, stopping each attachment cleanly at the existing edges.

frames.visible_job: Adds one upright tail fin and exactly two horizontal stabilizers at the established tail base.
frames.instruction: Raise one tapered tail fin from the rear fuselage. Attach one near horizontal stabilizer sweeping down-left and one smaller far stabilizer peeking above the tail, keeping all three surfaces rooted at the same tail base.

frames.step_name: Fit the cockpit windows and door
frames.visible_job: Adds one cockpit window group, exactly four cabin windows, and one passenger door seam along the unchanged fuselage.
frames.instruction: Curve one dark cockpit window group around the upper nose, then place exactly four separate rounded cabin windows along the same rising line. Add one rounded rectangular door seam behind the cockpit, keeping it clear of the near wing root.

frames.visible_job: Adds two small clouds, two trailing motion dashes, two open-paper highlights, one door dot, one teal engine ring, and one broken navy shadow accent.
frames.instruction: Place exactly two small puffy clouds in open paper away from the plane, then draw exactly two short parallel dashes trailing behind the tail. Reserve one long fuselage highlight and one shorter near-wing highlight, add one small round dot on the established door, ring the established engine intake with teal, and place one small broken navy shadow accent beneath the airplane.
adds: door dot and teal engine ring
introduces: door dot and teal engine ring

final_step.visible_job: Fills the established airplane, clouds, and shadow with saturated marker color while preserving every contour and paper highlight.
final_step.instruction: Fill the established fuselage coral, the near wing and tail fin teal, the far wing and stabilizers warm yellow, the engine coral around its teal ring, the windows deep navy, and the two clouds pale blue. Deepen the existing navy shadow accent and two motion dashes while preserving both open-paper highlights and adding no new structure.
adds: saturated marker color on established forms

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one thick, handmade, closed fuselage contour rising gently from a narrow left tail base to a broad rounded right nose. It fixes the final pose and proportions with one copyable connected form while wings, engine, tail surfaces, windows, door, sky marks, highlights, shadow, and color remain absent.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: Compared all six saved crops pairwise. The rising fuselage, two wings, one engine, one tail fin, two stabilizers, cockpit group, four cabin windows, door, two clouds, two motion dashes, two highlights, door dot, teal intake ring, and broken navy shadow remain at stable anchors. The finish adds saturated marker fills only to established contours and preserves the face-free silhouette and handmade grain.
